shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo "---"; ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50

set -e
echo "add book 1:"
B1=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Project Hail Mary","author":"Andy Weir","notes":"So far so good"}')
echo "$B1"
ID1=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(process.argv[1]).id)" "$B1")

echo "add book 2:"
B2=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert"}')
echo "$B2"
ID2=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(process.argv[1]).id)" "$B2")

echo "list:"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books

echo -e "\nmark book2 finished:"
curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:3000/api/books/$ID2 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"finished"}'

echo -e "\nupdate notes on book1:"
curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:3000/api/books/$ID1 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"notes":"Loved the ending"}'

echo -e "\nfetch single book (shareable link data):"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books/$ID1

echo -e "\ndirect link page status:"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/$ID1

echo -e "\n404 case:"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books/does-not-exist

echo -e "\nvalidation case (missing title):"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"author":"No Title"}'

echo -e "\n\nfile on disk:"
cat /workspace/data/books.json

pkill -f "node server.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
(node server.js &) && sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log('after restart:',d.toString()))"
pgrep -af "node server.js"; echo "---"; nohup node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & disown; sleep 1; cat /tmp/server.log

echo "books after restart:"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books
echo; echo "index page status:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
echo "app.js status:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/app.js
echo "style.css status:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/style.css
ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d)[0].id))")
echo "direct link for book $ID:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/$ID
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | head -3
pkill -f "node server.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; pgrep -af "node server.js" || echo "stopped"
